frontmatter.title: App shell
frontmatter.description: Mount application providers once, then compose a page header, content area, and responsive navigation.

frontmatter.title: Button
frontmatter.description: Choose an action style, name icon controls, and handle loading or unavailable actions without losing context.

frontmatter.title: Code editor
frontmatter.description: Edit code, JSON, YAML and templates with highlighting, completion and inline problems, and leave the field with the keyboard.

frontmatter.title: Data core
frontmatter.description: Summarize, shape and compare JSON values, and name a place in one with a JSON pointer — pure functions, no React.

frontmatter.title: Data table
frontmatter.description: Connect rows, search, selection, loading, and paging to one consistent list surface.

frontmatter.title: Dialog
frontmatter.description: Open a labelled modal, manage confirmation state, and return focus to a useful place.

frontmatter.title: Field issues
frontmatter.description: Show a check's problems under the field they belong to, take the reader there with the range selected, and say why Save is off.

frontmatter.title: Flow node issues
frontmatter.description: Mark the nodes of a flow canvas with their problem counts, in a way that reads without colour or sight.

frontmatter.title: Input
frontmatter.description: Build labelled text fields with validation, read-only states, and appropriate password or secret handling.

frontmatter.title: Issue list
frontmatter.description: List problems a check found in the reader's words, take the reader to each one, and count and announce the result.

frontmatter.title: Property list
frontmatter.description: Line up a record's properties beside their labels, and offer them as chips under a form.

frontmatter.title: Recurrence picker
frontmatter.description: Let people choose how something repeats, or when a schedule runs — one-click presets or a custom rule — and show the dates or runs it produces.

frontmatter.title: Schedule occurrence list
frontmatter.description: Show the next times a schedule starts, in the schedule's time zone, with the reader's own time and any clock change spelled out.

frontmatter.title: Schema tree
frontmatter.description: Show the fields a value has, with each kind in words, whether it is required, and where it comes from.

frontmatter.title: Tabs and navigation
frontmatter.description: Choose local panels or route navigation, preserve drafts deliberately, and keep every destination reachable.

frontmatter.title: Conversation thread
frontmatter.description: Show chat turns, task comments and what happened between them in one calm reading column.

frontmatter.title: Time field
frontmatter.description: Let people enter a time of day in their own hour cycle, with segmented parts they can step, type or paste.

frontmatter.title: Toast
frontmatter.description: Show brief completion feedback, avoid duplicate viewports, and keep essential information on the page.

frontmatter.title: Workflow canvas
frontmatter.description: Draw a workflow from its data with an automatic layout, lines that route round every box, a keyboard path through it and a List view that says the same in text.

frontmatter.title: Workflow paths
frontmatter.description: Show every way a run can go through a workflow, preview and pin one path at a time, and point out the nodes that end a run when they fail.

frontmatter.title: Workflow playback
frontmatter.description: Show how a run went on a workflow chart, and replay it with values travelling the lines, a scrubber and the failure in focus.

frontmatter.title: Accessibility
frontmatter.description: Combine the components with clear names, keyboard paths, readable contrast, and motion-aware behavior.

frontmatter.title: Colours
frontmatter.description: Choose semantic surface, text, status, and chart colors that can adapt to light and dark themes.

frontmatter.title: Icons
frontmatter.description: Use consistent Lucide glyphs, supply accessible names, and preserve usable pointer targets.

frontmatter.title: Spacing and layout
frontmatter.description: Align controls, choose shared containers, and keep content usable when the available width changes.

frontmatter.title: Typography
frontmatter.description: Choose text styles without confusing visual size with the page's semantic heading structure.

frontmatter.title: Internationalization
frontmatter.description: Supply translated component labels, merge service catalogs, and keep locale behavior consistent.

frontmatter.title: Installation
frontmatter.description: Connect source imports, styles, translations, and providers to render your first Tale control.

frontmatter.title: Introduction
frontmatter.description: Build with the MIT-licensed React components behind Tale. Choose a package for your screen and find a working example.

frontmatter.title: Theming
frontmatter.description: Enable light and dark themes, choose semantic colors, and apply an optional host accent.

frontmatter.title: Marketing UI overview
frontmatter.description: Build public-facing page sections with host-owned copy, routing, and clearly labelled product illustrations.

frontmatter.title: List page
frontmatter.description: Build a collection screen with one create action, connected search, and honest loading and empty states.

frontmatter.title: Settings page
frontmatter.description: Align configuration fields and connect Save, Discard, validation, and unsaved-change protection.
